items.title: Apple Patches Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in iOS 26.1 and iPadOS 26.1
items.description: Apple released iOS 26.1 and iPadOS 26.1, addressing multiple vulnerabilities that could lead to privacy breaches, app crashes, and potential data leaks for iPhone and iPad users.
